title: The Ledger of the Warren
setting_summary: Deep beneath a ruined abbey, a warren of rabbits lives packed into a warren of tunnels where every mouthful of stored root and every breath of air is tallied by a single ancient Ledger. A long drought above has sealed the burrows, food dwindles, and the Keeper of the Ledger rations survival by decree, while whispers of dissent spread through the cramped dark.
